notes: lead_magnets: [{ "keyword": "GUIDE", "name": "the pricing guide", "how": "comment | dm | link", "link": "" }]. formats: a format set to false isn't planned. scheduler.name: the tool's name (buffer, metricool, contentstudio, later, hootsuite, flick, none...); template: a CSV the scheduler gives you, saved in studio/brand/. mix: full (5 to 8 reels, 10 carousels, 10 posts per episode) or light. checkpoint: plan (show the plan before building) or none. tools: what the member records with, where files and notes live, how lead magnets are delivered, the booking tool, the design tool, and anything the studio must never read or touch. budget: the Claude plan, the monthly ceiling for generated pictures, and the minutes a day the member will spend reviewing. retention.action: delete or move (to move_to). raw_footage: after_all_posted or keep. copy_video: true copies videos into the episode folder; false leaves them where they are.
